name: Vladimir Putin
summary: A conservative nationalist who centralized power in Russia, built state-controlled energy champions alongside a flat tax, and promotes traditional family, religious and national values. Abroad he opposes a U.S.-led 'unipolar' order and NATO expansion, and launched the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
